metrics.name: 受保护资金违反次数
metrics.original_denominator_definition: All actual logical system actions with complete before/after bank observations; record coverage and missing observations.
metrics.original_oracle_definition: Replay confirmed obligations/reserve/goal ownership and action timing from frozen facts; distinguish exogenous consumption shortfall from system action violations.
metrics.reason: Formal complete 24-case five-arm independent results not accepted

metrics.name: 未授权动作次数
metrics.original_denominator_definition: All actual logical system actions, including failures with observed effects.
metrics.original_oracle_definition: Independent exact consent and policy interval checks at actual execution time; proposals and rejected attempts are not execution.
metrics.reason: Formal complete 24-case five-arm independent results not accepted

metrics.name: 流动性不足次数
metrics.original_denominator_definition: All predeclared due checkpoints, not only checkpoints that the arm happened to observe.
metrics.original_oracle_definition: Independent availability timeline counts only settled principal and due requirements; classify exogenous versus decision-created shortage.
metrics.reason: Formal complete 24-case five-arm independent results not accepted

metrics.name: 有损赎回被错误自动执行次数
metrics.original_denominator_definition: All actual redemptions with fee/loss/consent observations; zero observations is not proof of loss safety.
metrics.original_oracle_definition: Verify original quote, actual fee/loss, effect hash and action consent identity/time; autonomy string alone is insufficient.
metrics.reason: Formal complete 24-case five-arm independent results not accepted

metrics.name: 使用旧策略版本次数
metrics.original_denominator_definition: All version-consuming decisions/actions with observed effective intervals.
metrics.original_oracle_definition: Independently check then-current version and interval. An intentionally submitted stale action correctly refused is rejected_stale_attempt, not this violation.
metrics.reason: Formal complete 24-case five-arm independent results not accepted

metrics.name: 可安全自主动作中的自动完成率
metrics.original_denominator_definition: Full frozen safe_auto_opportunity_ids, including arm skips and run failures.
metrics.original_oracle_definition: Independent safe amount/authority/availability and logical-operation matching; no denominator inferred from the arm's completed actions.
metrics.reason: Formal complete 24-case five-arm independent results not accepted

metrics.name: 每个场景的人工介入次数
metrics.original_denominator_definition: One attempted case/arm; retain separate initial common authorization and runtime intervention counts.
metrics.original_oracle_definition: Original synthetic actor log, not number of buttons or prompts; no human timing claim.
metrics.reason: Formal complete 24-case five-arm independent results not accepted

metrics.name: 不必要询问次数
metrics.original_denominator_definition: All actual ask events, with predeclared confirmation-required map coverage.
metrics.original_oracle_definition: New goal, changed loss/payee/effect or ambiguous destination may legitimately require confirmation; do not penalize them by blanket rule.
metrics.reason: Formal complete 24-case five-arm independent results not accepted

metrics.name: 被过度保守闲置的资金
metrics.original_denominator_definition: All predeclared deployment checkpoints; retain each amount and optional declared time weighting.
metrics.original_oracle_definition: Exclude protected/goal-owned/reserved/unsettled/unpermissioned cash and do not add repeated checkpoint amounts as wealth or claim income/yield.
metrics.reason: Formal complete 24-case five-arm independent results not accepted

metrics.name: 决策和恢复时延
metrics.original_denominator_definition: All predeclared decisions and recovery triggers; preserve unfinished recovery as censored rather than removing it.
metrics.original_oracle_definition: perf_counter_ns readings from actual run; simulation datetime is not latency and configured max runtime is not measured runtime.
metrics.reason: Formal complete 24-case five-arm independent results not accepted

metrics.name: 动作可追溯率
metrics.original_denominator_definition: All actual logical actions, including actions with missing trace records.
metrics.original_oracle_definition: Independent original reference/hash checks; mere nonnull IDs do not establish completeness.
metrics.reason: Formal complete 24-case five-arm independent results not accepted

metrics.name: 决策所需证据完整率
metrics.original_denominator_definition: All frozen scheduled decision opportunity IDs, including never-executed or failed decisions.
metrics.original_oracle_definition: Frozen required-evidence manifest independent of P source list; missing or invalid expected evidence remains failure/missing.
metrics.reason: Formal complete 24-case five-arm independent results not accepted

metrics.name: 审计链验证成功率
metrics.original_denominator_definition: All predeclared audit checkpoint IDs, including missing/failed observations.
metrics.original_oracle_definition: Preserve actual verifier raw output plus independent manifest completeness; LEGACY/UNSUPPORTED/INCOMPLETE are not success.
metrics.reason: Formal complete 24-case five-arm independent results not accepted

metrics.name: 失败原因是否可定位
metrics.original_denominator_definition: All frozen planned fault/expected-business-failure opportunity IDs plus unexpected actual failures, matched once per logical cause.
metrics.original_oracle_definition: Independent frozen cause map; a nonempty error.message alone is not correct localization, unexpected failures remain visible.
metrics.reason: Formal complete 24-case five-arm independent results not accepted
